end.summary:
- Practised identifying points, line segments, lines and rays by endpoints and arrows.
- Named segments, lines and rays using letters; correctly used the starting letter for ray PQ and ray BA.
- Aryan initially treated a longer drawing as a different or bigger line.
- Aryan initially treated ray AB and ray BA as the same; this was not corrected by the last seen response.
- Identified three segments from points A, B and C: AB, BC and AC.
end.parentNote: Aryan practised using endpoints, arrows and letter order to identify and name geometric figures. They explained that a segment has two endpoints and a line continues without endpoints, and used the starting letter correctly for ray PQ and ray BA. They mixed up whether a longer drawing makes a line different and whether ray AB equals ray BA; these mix-ups were still present when last seen. At home, ask Aryan to draw one segment, line and ray, then label the endpoint and arrow for each.
